castle-farm-kent.description: This original piece was inspired by the castle farm in Kent, with its charming farmhouse and picturesque landscape.

weston-colville.description: Weston Colville shows a quiet path cutting through a golden summer field under a soft sunset sky.

suffolk-meadows.description: Suffolk Meadows captures a wide, peaceful view of summer fields and green hedgerows stretching to the horizon.

natures-journey.description: Natures Journey captures a quiet country trail through a summer field in the late afternoon.

somewhere.description: The peaceful stillness of a warm summer day over a golden wheat field under a clear blue sky.

where-the-storks-gather.description: Under a soft summer sky, graceful storks rest amid the swaying grasses and wild blooms of a sun-drenched meadow.

the-view-from-the-other-side.description: A country path winding through green grass and wild flowers next to a river under a clear blue sky in East Anglia.

light-between-the-birches.description: This artwork features a vibrant field of dandelions set beneath a sunny sky, framed by birch trees. The piece captures a bright, natural landscape scene.

the-dandelion-field.description: Inspired by spring days and the sinmple beaty of wild dandelion fields.

a-quiet-winter-evening.description: This painting captures a calm winter landsacpe with soft snow, muted earthy tones, and a simple rural scene. The compostion has a timeless peaceful feel with a gnetle sense of stillness and warnth.

winter-light-over-the-hills.description: Inspired by the Countrside in the South West of England: Peaceful, bright and untouched beneath a clear blue winter sky.

twilight-over-frozen-meadows.description: This painting captures a quite winter envening, snow covered fields beneath the fading light of the winter sun.

winter-in-woodlands.description: Snow covered landscape of a peaceful winter scene.

costwold-in-bloom.description: Inspired by Cotswold Lavender fields, this painting captures vibrant British summer with rows of deep violet and soft purple in full bloom.

grantchester-meadows.description: This painting depicts the serene beauty and expansive landscape of Grantchester Meadows, Cambridge.

scent-of-summer.description: This origianl piece was inspired by the lavander fields and peaceful landsacpe of the Cotswolds.

across-the-quiet-land.description: The composition blends gentle hills and soft, textured grasses that captures the expansive, peaceful atmosphere unique to Suffolk and East Anglian landscapes under big summer skies

burnham-overy-windmill.description: This painting captures the quiet majesty of the iconic Burnham Overy Windmill standing over the Norfolk countryside

warm-days-in-the-meadow.description: A peaceful countryside scene on quite summer afternoon.

where-memories-live.description: This painting is inspired by quiet rural landscape. The grey blue sky reflects a calm, overcast day, not dramatic, but still full of mood. The wheat field adds a sense of continuity that captures  the peacefulness and subtle beauty of the place.

summer-light.description: Inspired by the Suffolk coutryside, this piece captures the gentle golden light that settles over the fields in late summer.

beneath-the-suffolk-sky.description: This painting shows a classic Suffolk view of open fields, distant hills, and sheep grazing beneath the sky.

golden-fields.description: This piece captures the warmth of a summer day across a wide, sunlit landscape in Cambridgeshire.

view-from-the-path.description: Inspired by the unique landscape of Happisburgh beach on the Norfolk Coast. A calm atmospheric scence that brings a touch of nature and mood into any space.

levington-creek.description: A peaceful view of wetlands and a distant row of trees stretches out under a blue summer sky in Levington Creek.

august.description: Red poppies blooming along the edge of a golden wheat field under a bright summer sky in August.

fields-of-yellow.description: A vast field of bright yellow rapeseed field looking out toward distant green hills under a blue summer sky.

norfolk-mist.description: Norfolk Mist captures the peaceful stillness of early dawn over a quiet countryside meadow filled with pink wildflowers.

dunwich-heat.description: Dunwich Heath shows a sea of pink and purple heather stretching toward a distant coastline and coastal cottages under a wide, cloudy sky.

evening-sun.description: A quiet country path leading through tall grass toward distant farm buildings nestled against a treeline under a soft sunset sky.

coton.description: Coton in Cambridgeshire captures a wide, breezy view of countryside fields filled with wild pink flowers on a bright day.

echoes-of-the-breeze.description: A historic windmill stands over a quiet countryside landscape under a soft, light blue sky.

countryside-calm.description: Countryside Calm captures the quiet stillness of a rural landscape.

amber-waves.description: This lively landscape painting captures the movement of golden grass swaying across a meadow on a windy day in Cambridgeshire.

meadow-serenity.description: Meadow Serenity is a landscape piece looking out across a field of wildflowers toward a cottage nestled quietly against tall trees under a bright morning sky

lavardens.description: Lavardens in France shows a wide harvest field leading toward a historic stone chateau settled among green trees under a bright blue sky.

rural-elegance.description: Harvest time over a green field with hay bales on a warm summer's day.

the-moment.description: A vast green meadow is shadowed by shifting storm clouds over Quy Fen, Cambridgeshire, in The Moment.

the-stillness-of-the-land.description: Rural landscape painting featuring golden harvest fields, a rustic barn with a red roof, and a vast open sky.

endless-fields-of-gold.description: A sun drenched rural landscape with a winding path through wheat fields, accented by wildflowers under a vast sky.

glow-across-the-fields.description: A serene rural scene filled with warm sunlight, with vibrant lush green fields stretching across the foreground and leading the eye toward a distant golden harvest field.

golden-linen-stacks.description: Golden Linen Stacks is a beautiful, sunlit rural scene featuring four golden haystacks standing in a golden field, surrounded by vibrant patches of purple wildflowers.

sunlit-petals.description: This Norfolk landscape piece captures a close-up of sunlit petals with vibrant colours and delicate details under a bright summer sky.

seasons-of-change.description: Seasons of Change is a tranquil Cambridgeshire landscape painting that beautifully captures the transition into autumn, with vibrant green fields and golden and amber autumn hues on the distant tree line beneath a bright blue sky.

summer-day.description: Summer Day is a bright and cheerful painting that captures the warmth and joy of a perfect summer day, with a vibrant meadow filled with colourful wildflowers scattered across green grass beneath a clear blue sky..

sheep-in-the-golden-fields.description: A peaceful painting depicting a flock of white sheep grazing in a sunlit meadow of golden grass, set against a beautiful line of birch trees under a gentle blue sky.

fields-of-amber.description: A serene countryside painting featuring amber fields, scattered hay bales, and a rustic barn beneath a gentle blue summer sky

whispers-of-wild.description: A tranquil countryside scene filled with vivid wildflowers, fresh green grasses, and slender birch trees glowing in warm daylight.

rural-charm.description: Rural Charm captures a peaceful countryside view of an old barn surrounded by green hedges and a clear blue sky.

ethereal-glow.description: Ethereal Glow captures a peaceful countryside landscape where shifting light hits an expansive green meadow beneath a dramatic sky.

moonlit-meadows.description: A quiet patch of bright green grass stands out against autumn trees and dried fields under a twilight sky in Moonlit Meadows.

simplicity-in-silence.description: A quiet view of rustic outbuildings and a small cluster of birch trees stretches across an open summer pasture.

path-to-serenity.description: Path To Serenity captures a bright countryside landscape where a lone tall birch tree stands over a curving path and sunlit fields.

golden-field.description: A winter scene capturing the quiet stillness of the art tower under heavy snowfall.

the-kuldiga-bridge.description: An ancient span of red brick arching gracefully over the rushing white foam of the Venta Rapid.

village.description: A quiet rural landscape where a vast field of tall grasses and wildflowers opens up toward a small countryside settlement.

jaunpils-castle.description: A historic majestic castle  with a distinct round tower standing next to a quiet river under a bright blue sky.

harvest.description: This landscape painting captures a glowing, amber harvest field dotted with rolled hay bales under an expansive sky

spring.description: This landscape painting is inspired by travels to the Baltics and captures a bright Spring day with an old wooden farmhouse flanked by blooming purple lilacs and tall birch trees along a winding country path.

stonehenge-in-smiltene.description: A mystical scene of Stonehenge in Smiltene, with ancient stones standing tall against a backdrop of a serene landscape.

happisburgh-lighthouse.description: This landscape painting captures Happisburgh Lighthouse in Norfolk rising from a golden wheat field under a light blue sky.

thornham-old-harbour.description: A painting of Thornham Old Harbour at low tide captures a rugged, coastal stillness unique to the North Norfolk shore.

a-winter-evening.description: This landscape painting captures a winter evening with deep indigos and bruised purples in the sky contrasting with blue-shadowed snow around a lonely barn and scattered hay bales.

nostalgia.description: This landscape painting captures a nostalgic scene of an old rural homestead, inspired by travels to the Baltics, featuring quaint rustic houses and a peaceful atmosphere.
